newsitem.title: USA: Grigsby 'unresigned' from Grigsby Brandford & Co.
newsitem.headline: Grigsby 'unresigned' from Grigsby Brandford & Co.

text.p: Calvin Grigsby, who resigned under a cloud last month from Grigsby Brandford & Co, has notified Dade County, Fla., that he is rejoining his former firm, county finance director Ed Marquez said Monday.
"Calvin has told us that he is going to come back into the firm," Marquez said during a meeting of the Dade County Finance and Trust Funds Committee. "He has unresigned."
Marquez said Grigsby relayed the information to him this morning by telephone.
